ns2:section.sectionText: This section will be taught online. Please see http://publish.illinois.edu/onlinestudentorientation/online-business-minor-courses/ for more information. This course will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, April 20, 2015 and to the campus on Monday, April 27, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
